The paper states that holistic evaluation involves three elements [H:p002:t3]:

HELM is the byproduct of an explicit two-step process: we taxonomize the space for language model evaluation, structured around use cases (scenarios) and desiderata (metrics), and then systematically select points in a way that reflects our priorities.
